Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `IOCaseTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/commons-io/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/IOCaseTest.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll read both the original test and the CUT to understand the code before improving it.Now I have a clear picture of the code. I'll improve understandability by:
1. Renaming the cryptic `assert0` helper to `assertAllZeros`
2. Adding the missing blank line between `test_checkCompare_functionality` and `test_checkEndsWith_case`
3. Adding brief clarifying comments for the platform-conditional SYSTEM assertionsNow I'll run the compile check.The improved test compiled successfully. The changes made were: renaming the cryptic `assert0` helper methods to `assertAllZeros` for clarity, adding the missing blank line between `test_checkCompare_functionality` and `test_checkEndsWith_case`, and adding brief inline comments explaining the platform-conditional `SYSTEM` assertions (e.g., "SYSTEM treats mixed-case strings as equal only on Windows (case-insensitive OS)").
